mapper.select: SELECT id, account, nickname, email, phone, password_hash, status, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE account = #{account} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.account, u.nickname, u.email, u.phone, u.status, u.created_at, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_code ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_codes, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_names FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND (u.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{q.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role x JOIN sys_role y ON y.id = x.role_id WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND y.role_code = #{q.roleCode} )
GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.id ASC
